short_blurb: From remodels to ground-up builds — your Hermosa Beach general contractor.
local_note: Hermosa Beach homeowners choose Palm Crest Builders for kitchen and bath remodels, room additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations. We know the local building department, design for Hermosa Beach's mix of housing styles, and manage design, permits, and construction with our own licensed crews. We build throughout Hermosa Beach, including Downtown Hermosa, North End, South End, and nearby neighborhoods. Every project is built to the California Building Code and backed by our workmanship warranty.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Hermosa Beach?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Hermosa Beach building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Hermosa Beach?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Hermosa Beach rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Hermosa Beach remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
